lines.text: Rehoboam gathers 180,000 warriors to fight Israel, but the LORD tells them through Shemaiah to return home.
Rehoboam fortifies cities in Judah and Benjamin and puts shields and spears in all of them.
The priests and Levites stand with Rehoboam, and the Levites leave their pasturelands because Jeroboam and his sons rejected them.
People from every tribe seeking the LORD follow the Levites to Jerusalem and support Rehoboam for seven years.
Rehoboam loves Maacah daughter of Absalom most and appoints Jeush son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers.
